Read `recommended-products/index.tsx`'s actual current code around the impression effect and the `cards`/`useRecentlyViewedRailVisibleCount()` usage. Trace this precisely — does `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` itself do its own slicing internally (meaning the container never even knows the sliced count), or does the container pass an already-sliced list? Construct a mental (or actual, via a quick reproduction if you have time) test case matching the scenario CodeRabbit describes (primary image fails to load, a fallback candidate is recovered) and check whether the recovered image really would appear twice in the resulting `slideImages`/gallery array.
